name: basic-retrieval
description: Baseline retrieval-quality dataset: seeded L1 memories with queries a coding agent would realistically issue. Measures Recall@K, MRR, and search latency for the FTS pipeline.

memories.title: Run unit tests
memories.content: npm test executes the Vitest suite once in run mode.

memories.title: Run a single test file
memories.content: npm test -- tests/core.test.ts runs one Vitest file.

memories.title: Local storage engine
memories.content: The SQLite database is the local source of truth; vector indexes are derived data that can always be rebuilt.

memories.title: Public API types
memories.content: Every public API exports an explicit TypeScript type.

memories.title: Windows loader failure
memories.content: Loading the native SQLite extension failed on Windows because of an architecture mismatch between Node.js and the compiled binary.

memories.title: Windows loader fix
memories.content: Reinstalling dependencies with the matching architecture restored the native loader on Windows.

memories.title: MCP tool registration
memories.content: MCP tools are registered in src/mcp/server.ts.

memories.title: Node version requirement
memories.content: The project requires Node.js 22.5 or newer because it uses node:sqlite.

memories.title: Migration backward compatibility
memories.content: Schema migrations must stay backward compatible with every released database version.

memories.title: Core decoupling
memories.content: The repository memory core must not depend on the MCP SDK so the CLI and future adapters can reuse it.
